rule: Exact match only. A build's identity string is <engine>:<engine_commit>:binary_sha256:<binary>:config_sha256:<sha256 of the config file map>:grid:<n>x<n>:build_sha256:<sha256 of the canonical identity>, the identity being schema, engine, engine_commit, binary_sha256, image, config_sha256, grid and centre_mapping. Any other string, the broad alias hotspot6:<binary>:grid:64x64 included, is another evaluator. A run is a build only when its image is proved by digest: its evaluation receipt's image_digest, its signed grant's scorer_image_digest and its signed manifest's statistic.evaluator.build are each exactly the build's recorded image_digest, as full strings. Nothing is trimmed or case-folded, a tag never counts, and a build whose image_digest is null is never matched. The label is the build's: it never clears a result's own qualifiers (diagnostic, unassociated, replay status).

identity.centre_mapping: GRID_CENTER: mean of 1, 2 or 4 central cells (pinned)

sources.binary_sha256: app/door/scorer.py EVALUATOR_BINARY_SHA256 (door-scorer pins the same binary)

image.note: operator-reported tag: it names the build and proves no image (image_digest does)

image_digest.note: the packet records no digest for this image (null), so no run is matched to this build until one is recorded

sources.config_sha256: the input files both gate-zero raw references share: docs/sentilab/diagnostics/SLAB-049/references/ascend910-tap25d-fig6a-raw-45mm/SHA256SUMS, docs/sentilab/diagnostics/SLAB-049/references/micro150-tap25d-fig5a-raw-45mm/SHA256SUMS
